text:
maya: kicking off a staged rollout for release redwood/v2.3.4 — starting traffic-sway at 5% for eu-west for 10m window. changewindow: 03:00-04:00 UTC. please watch lat/5xx.
DeployBot: deploy initiated by maya for redwood/v2.3.4 -> fraction:5% target:eu-west mode:staged
jon: noted. are we pinning this variant or allowing automatic fallback?
luca: prefer pinning to avoid drift across runtime variants. /deploy pin redwood/v2.3.4@eu-west
tess: quick FYI — release notes pushed to /releases/2.3.4 and QA already signaled ok on sample prompts. :thumbsup:
sre-alerts: alert subscription added for eu-west latency and 5xx rate. threshold: 0.8% 5xx or +25% p50 latency.
DeployBot: traffic-sway progress: 1m in, 5% routed, health checks passing
jon: spotted slight qps bump on edge-3 but no errors yet. leaning continue.
luca: heads-up — KV cache evictions up ~10%, not critical but monitor.
maya: agree continue unless alerts trigger. keep scoreboard in this thread. if 5xx >0.8% we pause and investigate.
DeployBot: health event: eu-west: 5xx = 0.9% over 2m -> auto-pause initiated. routing reduced to 0%.
maya: pausing manually confirmed. thanks DeployBot. tagging infra to investigate root cause.
jon: can someone grab logs for the pinned variant? command: `kubectl logs -l release=v2.3.4 -n inference --since=10m`
luca: grabbing logs now, seeing tokenizer OOMs on a subset of nodes. looks like memory pressure when sequence >2048.
tess: opening a bug and rolling back model-quant profile change in the pinned image. brief rollback plan: revert quant-change, redeploy to small wave.
maya: decision: rollback model quant tweak -> roll forward with previous quant profile. roll started, will report back in 8m. :eyes:
DeployBot: rollback triggered by maya for redwood/v2.3.4@eu-west -> action: revert image to redwood/v2.3.3-quantA
sre-alerts: alert cleared for eu-west 5xx. monitoring for regressions.
jon: confirmed 0% traffic and then steady recovery once rollback completed. moving to slow reintroduce at 2% after postmortem.
maya: thanks all. postmortem note: avoid enabling quantA on this hardware profile without a canary variant. follow-up: add a preflight that simulates long sequence tokens in CI. filing tasks.
DeployBot: thread closed by maya after rollback.
